sources.title: Just Do It catalog skills
sources.licenseNotes: Original catalog content in this repository under LICENSE (MIT). No external redistribution dependencies. Attribution not required beyond MIT notice.
sources.validationOutcome: Security/quality: instruction-only SKILL.md files; MCP tools do not execute skill scripts. Import gate requires explicit sourceId. Decision: ship as sole catalog source for MVP (docs/source-policy.md, ADR-002). External brainstorm inventories are not imported.
knownLimitations: Pin commitOrRelease to an immutable git tag (e.g. v0.1.0) when cutting a release.
Project memory requires Node.js >=24 so node:sqlite includes FTS5 (ADR-003).
